tools.description: List every registered runtime driver from one coherent cached view, sorted by driver_id.
tools.name: helianthus.runtime.list

tools.description: Get one registered runtime driver from the coherent cached view.
tools.name: helianthus.runtime.get

tools.description: Request desired RUNNING for one driver. Answers after durable acceptance with desired state and revision only; observe completion through list or get.

ExpectedRevision.description: The driver's desired_revision read back from list or get: a canonical nonzero unsigned 64-bit decimal string.

tools.name: helianthus.runtime.start

tools.description: Request desired STOPPED for one driver. Answers after durable acceptance with desired state and revision only; observe completion through list or get.

ExpectedRevision.description: The driver's desired_revision read back from list or get: a canonical nonzero unsigned 64-bit decimal string.

tools.name: helianthus.runtime.stop

tools.description: Request one replacement of a driver whose desired state is RUNNING. Every accepted call takes a new desired revision; after a lost response, read back before retrying.

ExpectedRevision.description: The driver's desired_revision read back from list or get: a canonical nonzero unsigned 64-bit decimal string.

tools.name: helianthus.runtime.restart
